parent_revision_reason: HQ red-team found missing structural-vs-semantic GYO firewall, source-coverage obligations, zero-arity handling and claim-ceiling precision.
gyo_control_result: 12/12 revealed calibration correct using relaxed discovery + deterministic GYO join tree + frozen leaf_relation + frozen transfer_join

source_and_semantics_contract.normalization: Freeze exact canonicalization code/hash and prove SAT-equivalence to the supplied source representation; duplicates/tautologies must be handled explicitly rather than silently changing claim scope.
source_and_semantics_contract.clause_partition: Every normalized clause occurrence is owned by exactly one discovered leaf; no clause may be dropped or duplicated by decomposition.
source_and_semantics_contract.variable_ownership: Every variable appearing in more than one leaf is included in the complete boundary scope of every such leaf; every non-boundary variable occurs in exactly one leaf.
source_and_semantics_contract.zero_arity_leaf: A boundary-empty leaf is solved independently. UNSAT terminates root UNSAT; SAT witness is retained for reconstruction and the zero-arity factor contributes TRUE without being discarded from provenance.
source_and_semantics_contract.local_relation: For each leaf boundary tuple, frozen lower primitives derive exact SAT/UNSAT with source-bound certificates. Missing admission is FAIL_LOCAL_RELATION, never guessed.
source_and_semantics_contract.lower_primitive_authority: Freeze exact primitive source hashes and inherited correctness/complexity scope before population generation.

join_tree_contract.hyperedges: One distinct semantic relation identity per leaf boundary scope; duplicate or subset scopes remain distinct constraints.
join_tree_contract.gyo_semantic_firewall: Removing a subset/duplicate hyperedge during GYO reduction must never delete or weaken its relation constraint. All original relation identities reappear as nodes in the reconstructed join tree or are attached with an explicitly equivalent structural reconstruction.
join_tree_contract.running_intersection: For every boundary variable x, all relation nodes containing x form one connected subtree.
join_tree_contract.tree_edges: Edge separator is the exact set intersection of adjacent relation scopes.
join_tree_contract.messages: Use complete relation tuples over edge separators; unary marginalization is forbidden unless exact factorization is separately proved.
join_tree_contract.transfer_backend: Prefer unchanged frozen transfer_join semantics if the reconstructed graph contract matches its assumptions; any code change creates a separately hashed implementation and must be independently replayed.

discovery_contract.separator_enumeration: Enumerate only candidate variable subsets of width <= frozen rho.
discovery_contract.separator_ranking: One deterministic frozen ranking with deterministic tie-breaks.
discovery_contract.backtracking: FORBIDDEN unless a separately proved polynomial bounded search schedule is preregistered before data generation.
discovery_contract.recursive_progress: Each accepted split yields >=2 nonempty proper clause children; exact clause-count descent is checked at every recursion node.

complexity_contract.separator_search: Fixed rho<=3 gives polynomial candidate enumeration plus explicit polynomial connectivity work.
complexity_contract.decomposition_tree: Prove a polynomial node bound from strict proper clause partition, charged in original encoded input size.
complexity_contract.scope_hypergraph: Construction and GYO/join-tree reconstruction are polynomial in explicit incidence size.
complexity_contract.relation_tables: Leaf boundary <=3 gives at most 8 tuples per leaf relation.
complexity_contract.join_messages: Only local tree messages over exact separator intersections; no enumeration of all global shared assignments.
complexity_contract.reconstruction: Charge witness choice, merge, source lift, root replay and certificate bytes.
complexity_contract.total: T_construct + T_discover + T_relation + T_join + T_reconstruct + T_verify <= one explicit polynomial in source bit length.

population_and_controls.blindness: New generator source, seeds, topology schedule, thresholds and implementation hashes are frozen before blind package generation. Old v1.1 blind packages remain unread and excluded.

claim_ceiling.finite_experiment_pass: May establish only PASS_SCOPED_ALPHA_ACYCLIC_SEMANTIC_JOIN_TREE_TRANSFER on the frozen generated population.
claim_ceiling.typed_class_lemma: Requires an independent formal coverage proof for the declared class in addition to experiment PASS.

promotion_rule: PASS repairs only the scoped composite-transfer lineage. Any frontier advance requires independent replay, proof review and a separate HQ decision.
